items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez establishes his jab well and uses a reset jab to put himself back in position.
items.quote: I love the way that Drod establishes his jab and once he'll throw the cross to keep himself in balance... he uses a really nice reset jab.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez does a good job of setting traps by using straight shots to the body to pull opponents' hands down.
items.quote: So for Daniel Rodriguez, really good job of setting traps, using the straight shots to the body to pull the hands down

items.claim: Euros Medic has fast-twitch muscles and is very explosive, which explains his many first-round finishes.
items.quote: He's got fast twitch muscles. He's very explosive... That's probably why he's got so many first round finishes is because he can get off the blocks really fast.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has more decisions than finishes in the UFC.
items.quote: A lot more decisions than finishes in the UFC.

items.claim: Euros Medic takes too many steps backwards and gets tall when pressured.
items.quote: I'm not convinced that Eos Medic has corrected that part to his game. I am not convinced that he has fixed that problem he has with taking too many steps backwards and getting tall.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is coming off a long layoff and time spent in a Mexican jail with less than ideal training situations.
items.quote: coming off a long layoff, coming off a very troubling time in your life where you spent a good chunk of time in a Mexican jail, having to train in a very, you know, I would say like less than ideal situation.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is very durable and difficult to finish.
items.quote: I don't know if he can finish Daniel Rodriguez, Daniel's very, very durable
